description: Removes a stock ticker from one of the user's ticker lists (watchlists). Use edgaralert_get_ticker_lists first to find the correct listId. Returns no content on success (204). Returns an error if the ticker is not found in the list.

listId.description: The ID of the ticker list to remove from. Get list IDs from edgaralert_get_ticker_lists.

ticker.description: Stock ticker to remove, e.g. AAPL.

name: edgaralert_remove_ticker_from_list
title: Remove ticker from watchlist
